user.title: Set up NOS Teletekst
user.description: Choose which pages to follow. Each page gets a sensor holding its text, ready for notifications, voice or a dashboard. You can change this later.

abort.already_configured: NOS Teletekst has already been added.

error.ongeldige_pagina: One of the page numbers is not valid. Use three digits, optionally with a subpage: 101 or 100-2.

instellingen.title: Which pages do you want to follow?
instellingen.description: Each page gets a sensor. Its state is the first meaningful line; the full text sits in the attributes, ready for a notification or a voice assistant. For example 101 for news, 601 for sport, 702 for weather.

data.entiteiten: What do you want per page?

data_description.trefwoorden: Each word gets a sensor that turns on as soon as it appears on one of your followed pages. Useful for a notification about your team, your town, or any topic you follow.
data_description.verkeer: Fetches page 730 and all its subpages: jams, closures and diversions from the ANWB. Costs six extra requests per round.
data_description.wegen: Each road gets a sensor that turns on as soon as there is a report for it. For example A15, A16, N3.
data_description.entiteiten: Tick what gets created. The image is off by default: it costs processing time and is mainly useful for notifications or an e-ink display. Anything you untick disappears from your list.

init.title: NOS Teletekst
init.description: What do you want to change?

menu_options.sensor_toevoegen: Create or edit your own sensor

sensor_toevoegen.title: Your own sensor
sensor_toevoegen.description: Point at the line of a page you want to follow. For example: page 702, the first line containing 'De Bilt', only the number, unit °C. An existing sensor with the same name is replaced.

data.alleen_getal: Only the first number on the line

data_description.pagina: It does not have to be a page you already follow; it will be fetched.
data_description.zoekwoord: Only needed when searching for a word.
data_description.regel: Only needed for a fixed line number. Line 1 is the top one.
data_description.eenheid: For example °C or km. Leave empty if it is not a number.

error.ongeldige_pagina: One of the page numbers is not valid. Use three digits, optionally with a subpage: 101 or 100-2.
error.geen_zoekwoord: Enter a word to search for.

abort.geen_eigen_sensoren: You have not created any sensors yet.

pagina_ophalen.name: Get page
pagina_ophalen.description: Fetches a teletext page as plain text.

pagina.name: Page
pagina.description: Page number, optionally with a subpage. For example 101 or 100-2.

zoeken.name: Search
zoeken.description: Searches for a word across the given pages.

paginas.name: Pages
paginas.description: The pages to search. Maximum of 30.
